reason: The clearing sky makes cleaning the array useful for restoring power to essential services.
expectation: Brushing removes settled dust and restores some solar output; I don't know whether another restart action is needed.

alternatives.reason: Restoring water also seems essential, but power seems a useful first step.

effect: The array now supplies power again, so I can reconnect the discovery case.
reason: The core must remain cold and the restored supply can take over from backup.
expectation: The case will switch to solar power while continuing refrigeration.

alternatives.reason: Restoring the water line is also essential, but I want to protect the core first.

effect: The case is now on station power, leaving the water line as the next obvious service to restore.
reaction: Reassuring that the discovery has a normal power supply again.
reason: Refilling the drained line seems like the way to restore water service.
expectation: The line will be refilled, assuming thaw and pump checks are complete.

effect: The pump expelled air and the tap works; the next goal is to return the plants to the window.
reaction: The detail of priming the line makes the restart feel concrete.
reason: Move the lettuce to the window as the new goal requests.
expectation: The lettuce trough will be placed on the growing shelf, perhaps needing water as well.

alternatives.reason: The potato trough needs to go there too; I picked lettuce first without a strong preference.

effect: The lettuce is in place; the potato trough still needs to join it.
reaction: A simple placement, with nothing particularly surprising.
reason: Return the other trough to the window to finish the stated goal.
expectation: The potato trough will also move to the shelf and the goal may complete.

effect: Both troughs are back at the window and the chapter is complete; watering them was optional here.
reaction: A quiet, welcome return to normal, though the placement itself was mechanically plain.

mostWorthwhile.text: Priming the exterior line was most worthwhile: the air being pushed out and water reaching the tap made the recovery tangible.

leastWorthwhile.text: The two separate trough placements felt repetitive, with little feedback beyond their new locations.

surprise.text: I expected the troughs might need watering, but returning both alone completed the chapter.

arbitrary.text: No action I took felt purposeless; cleaning the array, reconnecting the case, priming the line and moving the plants all followed the situation.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue for the discovery in the ice and what happens after the storm, although this chapter's decisions were mostly straightforward.
